title: Arcade, which helps companies manage which actions AI agents are authorized to take, raised a $60M Series A led by SYN Ventures, following a $12M seed in 2025 (Steven Rosenbush/Wall Street Journal)
summary: Steven Rosenbush / Wall Street Journal: Arcade, which helps companies manage which actions AI agents are authorized to take, raised a $60M Series A led by SYN Ventures, following a $12M seed in 2025 — The startup aims to help companies manage the challenge of determining which actions AI agents are authorized to take
